description: Election Commission - Mr. M. J. Ithayaraj was elected as the member of the Valikamam North Pradeshiya Sabha
categorisation: This gazette content specifically addresses the filling of a vacancy in a local government body (Valikamam North Pradeshiya Sabha) under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It deals with electoral processes, including the nomination and declaration of a member to fill a vacancy caused by a member ceasing to belong to their political party. This falls squarely under Election Gazettes (Type 7) which cover electoral processes, candidate nominations, and declarations related to local authority elections.
